## Triage: first grade — `documentation` · `priority:p2` · `domain:spec` · `area:ai` · `pm:queue`. The strict nav item's `label` states the null ⇒ inherit rule, in lockstep with its twin

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-01T21:58Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

**Why p2, one above #20841's p3.** This is the describe the design model actually reads, on every first AI build (cloud's `propose_blueprint` output contract). Its silence steers the model to write labels, which defeats the render-time inheritance that the objectstack-ai/cloud#2021 ruling enables. #20841 fixed the lenient twin, which no model reads on that path.

**Routing.** `packages/spec` is `domain:spec`. `area:ai` follows #20841.

**Direction** (the card's own, accepted):
- `StrictNavItem.label`'s describe states the rule in the strict form: `null` ⇒ the entry shows its target's current label and follows renames. A label is written only when the entry must read differently.
- One pin holds the two `label` describes to one rule, beside the existing `viewName` lockstep pin.
- ⛔ No applier-side text matching. ⛔ No new gate.

**Downstream:** cloud's golden-journey measurement is the cloud seat's, after its pin carries this.

## ACCEPT — PR #21309 @ `f7fee5be0e`

`domain:spec` seat 1 (`session_01UtnxvdiN376GF3sgXwAw4d`), holder of claim `5944357787` · 2026-10-02T04:16Z

- **Shape (read on GitHub):** a draft against `main`. The first line is `Fixes #21248`, the second `Clause-②: no`. PR assignee `os-sales`. 3 files, +51 / -1: the `StrictNavItem.label` describe with a lockstep comment in `packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.zod.ts`, one rule pin in `solution-blueprint.test.ts`, and the changeset. No `content/docs/releases/`, and no governed path.
- **At-tier review:** owed (non-test `packages/spec/src/**`). Record `5945476461` names this landing head `f7fee5be0ec20b5124a5261fb1260d154a3e65c6` and reads **VERDICT: PASS** at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. It found:
  - The describe is true at the renderer. A model `null` reaches storage only as an absent `label`, and objectui's `resolveNavItemLabel` at the pin inherits on an absent label at render time and renders a present string verbatim.
  - The pin holds the two `label` rules equal, not their wording. It reds under either side's drift and stays green under a joint rewording.
  - The shape `z.string().nullable()` is unchanged. `patch` with `Clause-②: no` is right.
- **Changeset prose, checked here sentence by sentence:** "strict mode makes every nav entry's `label` a required decision" is true, because the strict mirror lists `label` with no `.optional()`. The `null` ⇒ inherit / string ⇒ verbatim sentence restates what the record verified at the pin. "Describe text only … accepts and refuses the same blueprints" matches the record's ①. "The model was steered toward writing one" restates the card's source report; the PR does not claim a new measurement.
- **Gates on this head:** 35 check-runs: 32 `success`, 3 skipped, none failed and none pending. `check-expected-skips`: OK, all 3 skips are on the roster. `check-governed-merges --pr 21309`: NOT governed, 52 changed lines. `mergeable_state: clean`. A local `git merge-tree` against `origin/main` `1371dc980c` merges without conflict. The two families the dev left NOT MEASURED locally (`Lint & Repo Gates` and the full spec repo project) concluded `success` in CI.
- **Out-of-scope findings:**
  - `StrictNavItem.viewName`'s describe uses label-named entries as its example. Acceptance notes: no wrong answer has been measured, so it is not class (a)/(b)/(c). The carrier is the cloud seat's golden-journey measurement after cloud's pin moves, if it attributes written labels to this example.
